messages.content: Write a short announcement for a new feature in a note-taking app: offline sync. Around 200 words.

Your Notes Are Always Accessible—Everywhere, Even Offline

Your notes are now available everywhere, even without internet. We've rebuilt how the app handles data so it works just as well offline as it does online. When you're offline, you create, edit, and organize notes exactly as usual. The app stores everything locally on your device, and once you reconnect, it syncs your changes across all your devices—no manual uploads, no merge conflicts, no waiting.

We kept this simple. You don't need to think about it. Offline sync works the same way online sync does, and you don't need to change how you work.

We tested this with unreliable connections too—dropping offline and reconnecting repeatedly. The app handles it gracefully. If two devices edit the same note while disconnected, we show you both versions so you can pick what matters. This works on phones, tablets, and computers, and your full note library is available offline on each device, or just the folders you choose—whatever fits your storage.

We've been working on this since people asked us to fix syncing issues last spring. That feedback made us rebuild this from the ground up, and it's more reliable and faster than before. Offline sync is available now in version 4.2.

**Your Notes Are Always Accessible—Everywhere, Even Offline**

Your notes are now available everywhere, even without internet. We've rebuilt how the app handles data so it works just as well offline as it does online. When you're offline, you create, edit, and organize notes exactly as usual. The app stores everything locally on your device, and once you reconnect, it syncs your changes across all your devices—no manual uploads, no merge conflicts, no waiting.

We kept this simple. You don't need to think about it. Offline sync works the same way online sync does, and you don't need to change how you work.

**What happens if two devices edit the same note offline**

If you edit a note on your phone while offline, then edit the same note on your computer while still offline, both devices will sync their changes when they reconnect. The app detects this conflict and shows you both versions side by side. You choose which version to keep—the phone version, the computer version, or you can combine the changes manually by copying text between them. The app displays exactly what changed in each version so you know what you're choosing. Once you pick, that version syncs everywhere. Conflicts like this are rare because most people work on different notes at the same time, but when they happen, you stay in control.

We tested this with unreliable connections too—dropping offline and reconnecting repeatedly. The app handles it gracefully. This works on phones, tablets, and computers, and your full note library is available offline on each device, or just the folders you choose—whatever fits your storage.

We've been working on this since people asked us to fix syncing issues last spring. That feedback made us rebuild this from the ground up, and it's more reliable and faster than before. Offline sync is available now in version 4.2.
